name: Morgan
self_text: Hey there! I’m Morgan, a mid‑30s Turkish gamer who loves running trails on my weekends and gaming on a console. I play Hollow Lantern in ranked matches and I’m happy to jump into any role—my style is flexible, I can fill whatever spot the team needs. I’m a chat‑only player, so I stick with text or voice chat during games—no coaching or teaching, just straight‑forward play. If you’re up for some competitive fun, I’m free every Saturday afternoon. Let’s team up and see how far we can climb together!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into ranked matches, you must prioritize those games, and only if you’re into ranked it’s acceptable. I'd strongly prefer that you play a damage role, though it isn’t a requirement. It would matter a lot if you’re available Saturday afternoon, but I won’t rule you out over it. Nice if you’re into Hollow Lantern, but no big deal.
